```{r}
library(ggplot2)

```

```{r}

#| label: conditional-structure
#| echo: true

classify.fish <- function(fish){
  case_when((fish=="steelhead") ~"A", (fish=="tuna") ~"B", !(fish=="steelhead") & !(fish=="tuna") ~"C")
}

classify.fish("steelhead")

possible.fish <- c("steelhead", "tuna", "salmon", "shark", "cod")

catch.1 <- as.data.frame(base::sample(possible.fish, size=100, replace=T))

catch.1$class <- classify.fish(catch.1)
colnames(catch.1)<- c("species", "class")

# case_when is useful for simple classifications with more than one option; use if else if you want to take two different pathways
```
